mentions.name: Print Relay
mentions.description: This is a cloud-based print relay system that enables remote printing to any printer connected to a local network. It consists of a cloud server and lightweight clients that connect printers to the cloud via WebSocket. It is PrintNode API compatible, serving as a self-managed alternative to the PrintNode SaaS.
mentions.problem: The author's workplace experienced connectivity/routing issues between AWS ap-southeast-2 and PrintNode's servers about twice a year, motivating a replacement for PrintNode.
mentions.audience: Businesses and workplaces needing reliable remote printing to printers on their local networks
